HtmlDescription:
Piston compressor 3HP / 90L single-stage with cast iron cylinder and belt driven.

 

Technical details:

 

  • Free air delivered: 20,2m3/h
  • Air pressure: 10bars
  • Engine power: 3HP / 2,2KW
  • Input current: 230V single phase / 50Hz
  • Tank capacity: 90L
  • Speed: 1350 rpm/min
  • Air outlet: 1/4" F
  • Dimensions L x w x H (mm): 1070 x 390 x 800
  • Weight: 69Kg

 

Caution:

To protect your pneumatic system, you are strongly advised to use an air treatment system and an automatic capacitor purge (ref. 892 887)
